List custom object schemas

Support:

| Provider    | Supported |
| ----------- | --------- |
| Hubspot     | Yes       |
| Salesforce  | Yes       |
| Pipedrive   | No        |
| MS Dynamics | No        |

Create custom object schema

Support:

| Provider    | Supported | Notes                                                   |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Hubspot     | Yes       | All field types supported except picklist/multipicklist |
| Salesforce  | Yes       | All field types supported except picklist/multipicklist |
| Pipedrive   | No        |                                                         |
| MS Dynamics | No        |

params.name: object_name
params.description: The unique name of the custom object. For Salesforce, this should end with __c. For Hubspot, this will typically be the singular form of the object.
